script: Chapter 5. Keyword Research. Every search has an intent: learn, go somewhere, compare, or buy. A page ranks only when it matches the intent. Check the current results before you write. Brainstorm seed keywords. Expand them with autocomplete and People also ask. Check the results. Group keywords into clusters, then map each cluster to one page. Practice: build a list of 60 keywords for a local business and map them to four pages. Recap: intent first, then clusters.
glossary: keyword research, search intent, keyword cluster, autocomplete, keyword map
